name: ways-of-working
description: A library of skills, playbooks, rules, and configs that capture one owner's ways of working, written so that any model, including cheaper and local ones, produces near-frontier output: Opus/Sonnet in Claude Code, free local models in Claude Code via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (Ollama, LM Studio), Antigravity, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any MCP-capable agent.
